periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation at approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval profile with a vertical height approximately double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, extending the lower margin significantly below the geometric center of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary with a wide, gentle curve across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad transverse band covering approximately 35-40 percent of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, approximately twice the width of a single ear's base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior boundary of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible white fur region on the posterior lumbar/caudal area and visible claws on the plantigrade-oriented left hind paw.
